References / Website / 96

*NSYNC website, 2000

The boy band’s Flash intro of August 2000: a wavy blue panel with a wide slanted logo, its mirror reflection, glowing blue orbs, and a member portrait in a halo.

Source
www.nsync.com (archived copy)
Creator
*NSYNC (Jive Records)
Made
2000 (capture date, 15 August 2000)
Style
Y2K aesthetic (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Glossy, pop, techno-optimistic
Evidence
Captured from the Internet Archive with tools/capture.mjs (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 28 September 2026 and inspected. The main panel is Flash content, which rendered in the capture. Nothing covers the page.
Reviewed
28 September 2026
Rights
Third-party work, stored with credit for commentary. License: unverified. Rights policy

Observed

  • The page background is flat teal-blue. A large panel of brighter blue with soft, wavy edges and rounded corners fills the center.
  • Four glossy dark-blue orbs with white highlights sit at the panel corners like rivets.
  • The logo is a big italic “N” with “SYNC” in wide, slanted, outlined capitals; a mirror image of the logo appears below, as on a glossy floor.
  • A member’s photo sits in a circle with a violet glow and a white lens-flare highlight; his name “CHRIS” is in light-blue italic capitals.
  • A purple star and horizontal speed lines sit behind the portrait. A red star with speed lines marks the “skip…” link.
  • Below the panel, a glossy black oval button reads “Get *NSYNC”, next to a plain email form and a Shockwave badge.

Why it belongs

This intro gathers many Y2K web devices in one frame: orb buttons, a mirror reflection, glow halos, lens flare, wide slanted type, and speed lines.

The pixel palette is almost all saturated blue (chromatic share 0.97). The CSS measurement sees only the plain HTML around the Flash.

Borrow

Put a mirror reflection of a wide logo under it on a glossy panel.

Use glossy orbs with one white highlight as corner rivets or buttons.

Circle a portrait with a soft colored glow instead of a border.
